lines.1: 「♪ Ahh... With a personality like mine, is a kiss a long way off...? I want to find a bond that can blow all my restless fears away!」
lines.2: 「♪ Only your joking voice and slightly awkward smile can turn these feelings into pride... ♪ No matter how many times we clash and get mad, it has to be you!!」
lines.6: 「Heheh. Not bad, huh? I'm pretty confident with J-pop!」
lines.7: 「So it's a karaoke score battle! Does that mean I win?」
lines.8: Somehow, this had turned into a competition.
lines.9: We'd been getting along fine until karaoke, but the moment we started talking scores, this happened!
lines.10: Why did we always end up like this?
lines.11: 「I thought you weren't used to karaoke, but you're good.」
lines.12: 「Not used to it...? You really didn't think of me as a normal high school girl, did you...? My crest is standing on end.」
lines.16: 「I really can't picture you breaking ninety!」
lines.17: 「Damn it. You already think you've won.」
lines.18: 「...I'll teach you not to be so cocky!」
lines.19: I switched to the song I always scored highest on.
lines.20: 「I'm the one who's going to win! Here goes. Leo Tsushima, with "The Dapper Magician"!」
lines.22: 「♪ A woman spoke to me in town when I was lost in sorrow... ♪ In my room, she warmed my sorrow until it melted away. ♪ How strange... ♪ She must be "The Dapper Magician"!」
lines.23: 「♪ When I woke up... ♪ She was gone. ♪ My bankbook was gone too. ♪ My will to live was gone. ♪ How strange... ♪ She must be "The Dapper Magician"!」
lines.24: 「What kind of song is that!? It doesn't have a shred of romance!」
lines.25: 「Mood has nothing to do with winning.」
lines.26: 「Wait, did you want me to set the mood?」
lines.27: 「N-no! You said today was supposed to be about showing me a good time, so I thought you'd sing something romantic I'd like!」
lines.31: 「Damn it! I can't believe I lost to that ridiculous song.」
lines.33: 「Hmph. Is it really fun to win when you've thrown all dignity out the window?」
lines.34: 「Ngh! My crest is standing on end! Don't underestimate me!」
lines.35: 「I'm going all out this time. I'll definitely beat you!」
lines.41: 「How about that, Tsushima!? Now you see the difference in our skill levels!」
lines.43: 「...(the look one gives a rare sight)」
lines.45: 「W-why are you suddenly cooling off now!? Stomp your feet and act frustrated! It's not fair if I'm the only one getting worked up!」
lines.47: 「Sorry, sorry. This time I wasn't doing it on purpose. Seeing you get so excited was kind of endearing.」
